about_the_game:
Enter a world where strategy, luck, and cooperation merge in a one-of-a-kind tower defense experience. Every decision counts in these fast-paced battles, and success depends not only on your skill but also on how well you adapt to chance and support your team.

Key Features:

  • Summon units through luck: Every summon is a roll of the dice! Will you get a powerful hero or a clever defender? Build your team based on chance, and turn luck into your greatest weapon.

  • Play co-op with friends: Join forces in cooperative mode and face challenges together. Plan your tactics, support each other, and push forward as a team. True synergy is the key to victory.

  • Merge units for unexpected upgrades: Combine units during battle to unlock stronger, more unpredictable abilities. Every merge is a new opportunity for power and surprise.

  • Spin the Lucky Wheel: Take a risk and spin for game-changing bonuses or rare units. Fortune can shift the outcome of the entire match—if you're brave enough to trust it.

  • Endure wave after wave of escalating challenges: Each wave demands more strategy, flexibility, and a bit of luck. Can you keep up as the pressure rises?

  • Three difficulty modes with unique enemies: Choose between Easy, Normal, and Hard modes. Each offers different types of enemies with unique behaviors and mechanics. The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards—and the greater the challenge.
